description: Shared fixture for TER-02's resolution algorithm. Not validated by tools/validate/validate_data.py (it lives under data/schema/, which discover_documents() excludes, the same way the schema files themselves are excluded) -- it exists only to be run through sim/content.py's resolve_terrain() and scripts/content.gd's resolve_terrain() and diffed tile for tile, by tools/terrain_parity.py and the 'terrain parsers agree' gate check. PRD-THEATRE-SCALE.md risk #10 is exactly these two parsers disagreeing on one tile, invisibly.

cases.name: regions
cases.note: region 2 overlaps region 1 and raises (z1 -> z2); region 3 overlaps the same tiles region 2 just raised and lowers them (z2 -> z1) -- overlap in both directions, on the same tiles, so a resolver that stops at 'the first region wins' or 'the highest z wins' fails this rather than a resolver that implements strict array-order overwrite. Region 4 is rect [6,3,4,4] on an 8x5 board: it runs off both the right and bottom edges and must clip, not wrap or error. Both ramps sit on the board boundary (y=h-1 and x=0) and must not perturb the resolved grid -- ramps are metadata, not consulted by resolve_terrain.

cases.name: heightmap-equivalent
cases.note: the escape hatch, hand-authored to the exact grid the 'regions' case above resolves to. Proves 'an anchor with regions and an anchor with the equivalent heightmap resolve to the same grid' (TER-02 acceptance criteria) directly -- both cases' `expected` are byte-identical on purpose.
